import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long x = sc.nextLong();
        long y = sc.nextLong();
        long n = sc.nextLong();

        double ratio = (double) x / (double) y;
        long bestNumerator = 0;
        long bestDenominator = 1;
        double smallestDiff = Double.MAX_VALUE;

        for (long denominator = 1; denominator <= n; ++denominator) {
            double approximate = ratio * denominator;
            long numeratorFloor = (long) Math.floor(approximate);
            long numeratorCeil = numeratorFloor + 1;

            double diffFloor = Math.abs(ratio - (double) numeratorFloor / denominator);
            double diffCeil = Math.abs((double) numeratorCeil / denominator - ratio);

            if (diffFloor < smallestDiff) {
                smallestDiff = diffFloor;
                bestNumerator = numeratorFloor;
                bestDenominator = denominator;
            }
            if (diffCeil < smallestDiff) {
                smallestDiff = diffCeil;
                bestNumerator = numeratorCeil;
                bestDenominator = denominator;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(bestNumerator + "/" + bestDenominator);
        sc.close();
    }
}
